  "pros": [
    "Highly flexible and customizable for various HR and project needs",
    "Excellent for centralizing company knowledge and documentation",
    "Ability to link pages and databases creates a powerful interconnected system"
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Steep learning curve initially, requiring significant setup time",
    "Can become overwhelming if not structured carefully from the start",
    "Transitioning from a more structured tool like monday.com required adjustment"
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This People Excellence Manager found Notion to be a powerful tool for knowledge and project management, appreciating its flexibility for HR-related tasks and company-wide documentation. The initial learning curve and the effort required to set up systems effectively were notable challenges, especially when coming from a more streamlined platform. Despite the initial hurdles, they recognized its strong potential for long-term organizational benefits."
